title: Pharmacy Benefits Note: Reinstatement Fee Cap for Medicaid and Medicare Members on Delivery & Pickup Services
content:
The reinstatement fee charged when a Delivery & Pickup Services plan settles an overdue cycle is capped according to the patient's primary prescription insurance record in active status, as held under Prescription Insurance on File. The reinstatement fee is reduced to its cap where the cap is lower than the fee.

## Caps

| Patient's primary prescription insurance record in active status | Cap on the reinstatement fee |
|---|---|
| Medicaid Managed Care Pharmacy Benefit | $0.50 |
| Medicare Part D Standard Plan, Medicare Part D Enhanced Plan or Medicare Advantage Prescription Drug Plan | $1.50 |
| any other class of record, or no primary record in active status | none; the reinstatement fee stands uncapped |

Only a coverage record that is both the patient's primary coverage and in active status counts; a terminated or removed record does not count, and neither does a secondary record.

## Hypothetical cases

| Reinstatement fee | Primary active record | Fee after the cap |
|---|---|---|
| $4.00 | Medicaid Managed Care Pharmacy Benefit | $0.50 |
| $2.00 | Medicare Part D Enhanced Plan | $1.50 |
| $4.00 | Medicare Advantage Prescription Drug Plan | $1.50 |
| $2.00 | Commercial Copay Plan | $2.00 |
| $4.00 | Medicare Part D Standard Plan, but terminated; no other active primary record | $4.00 |
| $0.00 | Medicaid Managed Care Pharmacy Benefit | $0.00 (the cap is not lower than the fee) |
